rules.name: no_third_party
rules.why: no one loses shares in others' calls

rules.name: deposit_fair
rules.expr: ok and called("depositMulti") and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("totalSupply") - pre("totalSupply")) * wide(pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) + pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0)) > wide(post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) + post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0) - pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) - pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalSupply"))
rules.why: shares minted never exceed value brought in relative to total holdings

rules.name: deposit_mint_sync
rules.expr: ok and called("depositMulti") and post("totalSupply") - pre("totalSupply") != post("balanceOf", sender) - pre("balanceOf", sender)

rules.name: deposit_brings_value
rules.expr: ok and called("depositMulti") and post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) + post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0) <= pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) + pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0)

rules.name: deposit_nonzero
rules.expr: ok and called("depositMulti") and post("totalSupply") <= pre("totalSupply")

rules.name: share_price_monotone
rules.expr: ok and pre("totalSupply") > 0 and post("totalSupply") > 0 and wide(post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) + post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalSupply")) < wide(pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) + pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(post("totalSupply"))

rules.name: withdraw_fair_A
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and wide(pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalSupply")) > wide(arg(0)) * wide(pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: withdraw_fair_B
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and wide(pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0)) * wide(pre("totalSupply")) > wide(arg(0)) * wide(pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: assets_out_only_withdraw
rules.expr: ok and (post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) or post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0) < pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0)) and not called("withdraw")

rules.name: no_third_party_token_loss
rules.expr: ok and u != sender and u != A0 and not called("MockToken_A.transferFrom") and not called("MockToken_B.transferFrom") and (post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", u) or post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", u) < pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", u))
rules.why: no token loss for others; direct transferFrom on a token by an approved spender is legitimate and excluded

rules.name: withdraw_pays_sender
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender != A0 and (post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", sender) != pre("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) or post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", sender) - pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", sender) != pre("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0) - post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0))
rules.why: what leaves the vault on withdraw goes to the caller

invariants.name: backed
invariants.expr: post("totalSupply") > 0 and post("MockToken_A.balanceOf", A0) + post("MockToken_B.balanceOf", A0) == 0
